$comment: Hotspot vocabulary (PRD 5.3), read by lib/hotspots.mjs at run time. Every string is a JavaScript regex fragment, not a literal: escape . ( ) [ ] ? * + | \ when you mean the character. Fragments must not open capturing groups; use (?:...). The code joins each list with | inside a group and fixes the flags, noted per list. Lists split by language (vi, en, ...) are joined in key order. Vietnamese text must be NFC (precomposed), as transcripts are. An entry is a string or {id, pattern, comment}. See docs/development.md before editing.

harnessText.$comment: User lines the harness injected, not the owner: the text starts (after spaces) with one of these. Flags: none.

blocked.$comment: A tool call the environment refused (hook veto, permission or sandbox refusal, worktree guard), matched in the first 400 chars of a failed result. Flags: i.

metricPair.$comment: A number pair joined by a connector, as in 4 301 → 1 360 or 0,667 lên 0,72.

connectors.$comment: Between the two numbers. Flags: g i u.

rangeConnectors.$comment: Connectors that also write a range (12 to 40 lines); the pair is skipped when a unitWords entry follows. Whole-connector match. Flags: i.

positionWords.$comment: A word right before the pair makes it a position range (rows 0 to 190), not a before/after. Followed by spaces. Flags: i.

idPrefixes.$comment: Characters right before the pair make it an id range (mapping-0241 to 0300, #12 to #14). Flags: i.

unitWords.$comment: A unit right after a range connector's second number (0 to 190 rows). Must end the word. Flags: i u.

gitReversal.$comment: Shell commands that undo or rewrite history. Heredoc bodies are ignored. Flags: none.

commands.comment: the code skips a plain rebase onto an upstream (see rebaseRewriteFlags, upstreams)
the code skips a checkout that only restores lockfiles

lessonWrite.$comment: Writes to lesson and decision records. kinds: label goes into the signal (ghi <label> <file>); pattern is tested against the slash-normalised path with its own flags (i, m, s, u allowed). copyCommands: shell commands whose last argument is a write target (besides > >> tee).

metaWrite.$comment: Agent configuration paths: a path segment starting with one of these. Lesson records win over this list. Flags: none.

ownerVoice.$comment: The owner speaking. Word lists must end the word (no letter follows). Flags: i u, except interrupt and choiceIds (none).

choiceIds.$comment: A turn that is only an option id, optionally (A), A. or A!: A, b2, 3, 1c.

address.$comment: Optional address word before a choice word (em chọn B).

choiceWords.$comment: Turn starts with one of these: answering a question with a choice.

pushbackStart.$comment: Turn starts with one of these: refusing or objecting.

pushbackAnywhere.$comment: Anywhere in a short turn: pushing back or hurrying the agent.
